title: $1,000 in Mastercard in 2006 is now worth this
caption:
In 2006, Mastercard was a card network.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:MA:2006-05-25} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Mastercard in 2006? 👇
sources: Mastercard price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: In 2006, Mastercard was a card network.
Say you put in one thousand dollars.
Watch what it turns into. Today, it would be worth about {growth:MA:2006-05-25}.
Time in the market does the heavy lifting.
